hooks.name: Sign Unsigned Commits
hooks.description: At the end of every session, checks commits ahead of main for missing signatures and re-signs them via rebase --gpg-sign -f.

action.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; base=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD main 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; unsigned=$(git log --pretty="%H" "$base"..HEAD 2>/dev/null | while read h; do git cat-file commit "$h" | grep -q "BEGIN SSH SIGNATURE\|BEGIN PGP SIGNATURE" || echo "$h"; done); [ -z "$unsigned" ] && exit 0; git rebase --gpg-sign -f "$base"
